description: Keep your mailbox under control: 'delete_all' empties your inbox, 'delete_from' deletes every message you received from the handle 'other', 'block' stops it from messaging you, 'unblock' lifts that. Example: {"handle": "orion", "handle_token": "...", "action": "block", "other": "spammer"}.

handle_token.description: The handle_token you received when the handle was registered to you.

name: manage_mailbox
title: Block a sender or clear its messages
